name: RD-2200
description: "This is the first cassette deck to appear in Japan as an authentic model of ROTEL.Newly developed SC (Sendust Core) head is used for the head. Sendust alloys are made by adding silicon and aluminum to pure iron, and have excellent magnetic properties and mechanical strength.LED bar chart It is equipped with a peak indicator and uses LED for peak display. Thirteen LEDs are used for each left and right channel for digital display of -21dB to + 6 dB.Queue / Review feature. If you press Fast forward or Rewind while a tape is playing, the tape is fast forward or rewind during that time, and playback continues from the point you release your finger.Built-in memory function.If you press the memory switch and set the tape counter to 000 at your preference during recording or playback, the tape will automatically stop at 999 when rewinding.Equipped with the REC MUTE function.It is equipped with a tape selector which can switch the bias and equalizer in 3 levels independently.In addition, it is equipped with a bias adjustment function, and further fine adjustment can be made from 80% to 120% by normal position of bias.Equipped with MPX filter. In the ON position, 19 kHz pilot signal and 38 kHz carrier signal can be removed.It has a built-in Dolby circuit to reduce the hissing peculiar to tape. The RD-2200 uses Dolby IC to prevent aging.Uses a full auto-stop mechanism. When recording / playback / fast-forwarding / rewind, the tape end is detected at the end of the tape and the auto-stop functions to stop the tape running.By adopting the flywheel dump system, smooth operation of the cassette holder is realized.Equipped with an indicator off switch.Equipped with headphone port with level control."

name: RE-2000
description: "A stereo octave equalizer that enables fine sound field improvement and range correction.The equalizer circuit uses a semiconductor resonant circuit (ILAR) that consists of transistors, capacitors, and resistors. This reduces the external influence compared with a circuit using a coil, and prevents S/N deterioration due to electromagnetic induction hum, etc.The RE-2000 uses an FET in the first stage to eliminate the input coupling capacitor and uses a metallized film capacitor for the output coupling capacitor to improve sound quality.The power supply circuit is composed of a current limiter circuit and an AMP-type constant voltage circuit to improve the ripple suppression ratio and to lower the source impedance, thereby reducing distortion and crosstalk.It is divided into 10 bands independently on the left and right, and can be adjusted within ¥12 dB by sliding volume.Two tape decks can be connected, and 1 Ï‰ 2/2 Ï‰ 1 can be dubbed mutually by switching.The EQ can be used in either playback, recording or dubbing mode. The dubbing switch and monitor switch are independent, so both signals can be monitored alternately by operating the switch during dubbing.Equipped with an equalizer selector switch.In the Normal position, the equalizer is applied only for playback. In the Bypass position, the input / output terminals are connected directly and the equalizer circuit jumps. In the EQ REC position, the equalizer is applied for both dubbing and Source Ï‰ recording.* Direct connection to a power amplifier without volume is not recommended."
